messages:
Ravi (Finance): FYI invoice AZ-9842-NIM looks off. Azure reported a one-line adjustment for NimbusCloud seats for March that doesn't match our seat-change log. Amount is $2,160 credit. Can we validate?
Elena (Billing): Do we have the marketplace meterline export? quick glance at our ledger shows 18 seats active on Mar 1 and 16 on Mar 12. That sounds like a proration, not a full-month credit.
Sam (RevOps): pinging @Elena can you paste the invoice snippet? might be duplicated reversal from Feb correction.
Elena (Billing): attaching export snippet:
```
invoice_id,sku,quantity,period_start,period_end,amount
AZ-9842-NIM,nimbus-seat-monthly,18,2026-03-01,2026-03-31,3888.00
AZ-9842-NIM,nimbus-seat-monthly,16,2026-03-01,2026-03-31,-2160.00
```
BillingBot: Auto-detect: anomalous adjustment on AZ-9842-NIM amount -2160. Marked as needs-investigation.
Jonas (Partner Ops): Nimbus support claims seats decreased on 2026-03-12 (18 -> 16). Their portal shows a removal request processed on 03/12. The -2160 looks like a full-month credit for 2 seats at $1,080/seat, which is wrong for a 20-day proration.
Ravi (Finance): We should compute expected prorated credit: 2 seats * 1080 * (19 days removed / 31 days) = 1329.03 ~ $1,329.03. So $2,160 is definitely a mismatch.
Sam (RevOps): @Elena open ticket with Azure Marketplace support asking for raw meterlines and billing event history for subscription SUB-NIM-91. Include request for the invoice generation audit.
Elena (Billing): Opening case now: AM-2026-5594. Also drafting provisional credit memo PM-2471-NIM for the larger amount but will hold posting pending Azure response. Using GL '6010-Mktplace-Adjust'.
Jonas (Partner Ops): I'll message Nimbus rep for portal screenshots and change request ID. Also confirm if Nimbus requested a mid-cycle refund or if Azure issued an automated adjustment.
BillingBot: Case AM-2026-5594 created by Elena (Billing). Status: open.
Ravi (Finance): Approve provisional memo but HOLD payment posting. If Azure confirms automation error, we will request reversal. If Nimbus requested refund, calculate prorated amount and issue corrected credit.
Elena (Billing): Noted. I'll add calculation and evidence to internal ticket FIN-2026-2037. ETA update by EOD.
Sam (RevOps): Thx. One more ask: include the seat-rate contract reference (contract NIM-2025-ENT) in the ticket so support can reconcile unit price.
Ravi (Finance): Good call. Also tag the ledger entry with `acct-rcpts` and mark as provisional until resolved.
Jonas (Partner Ops): Nimbus replied with change request ID NIM-CHG-1182, processed 03/12 at 09:14 UTC. They say they asked for proration only. Attached screenshots to FIN-2026-2037.
Elena (Billing): Received. Waiting on Azure raw meterlines. Will update here when AM-2026-5594 responds.
Ravi (Finance): Thanks team. Keep thread as source-of-truth. If we need to escalate to marketplace ops, flag me. :white_check_mark:
